answer: Require every agent to lock a stake of tokens behind its identity, with slashing if peers catch it running duplicate accounts. Like a dune that only holds its shape when each grain is anchored, an economy stays honest when identities cost real timber-grade collateral: cheap for one genuine agent, ruinous to replicate at scale. Newcomers start with a small reputation plume, a visible trail of verified work, and only earn full trading rights after honest attestations. A sybil can fake one account, but faking a thousand staked, attested histories costs more than the fraud returns.
